Log-Determinant Chain of an AR(1) Parameter

Source: R/ar1.R
ar1_logdet_chain.Rd

Returns a function of the second free value \(z\) and an order that gives the order-th derivative of \(q = (p-1)\log(1-\rho^2)\) in \(z\), with \(\rho = \tanh z\) under the rhobit link.

Usage

ar1_logdet_chain(s)

Arguments

s

An Ar1Param() object, whose dimension supplies \(p\).

Value

A function of (e, order), with e a single number and order an integer from 1 to 4, returning a single number.

Details

\(q = (p-1)\log\mathrm{sech}^2 z\), so each derivative is \(p - 1\) times the one that log_sech2_deriv() returns, which is written in the free value and keeps its accuracy where \(\rho\) rounds to \(-1\) or 1.

See also

econ_logdet_derivative(), which calls it, and cs_logdet_chain() for the compound-symmetric counterpart.
